summary: Reactive validation rules and validation binding support for ViewModels and forms.
recommendedPatterns: Use ValidationRule and BindValidation instead of ad hoc imperative validation glue.
Implement IValidatableViewModel or inherit ReactiveValidationObject when needed.
Keep validation messages and formatting consistent.
avoidPatterns: Do not sprinkle stringly-typed validation errors through the UI layer.
Do not keep validation logic in the view when it belongs in the ViewModel.
setupSteps: Create validation rules close to the relevant properties.
Bind validation output in the view.
commonPitfalls: Forgetting to target the property explicitly in observable validation rules.
Duplicating validation rules in multiple layers.

packageSelection: Add ReactiveUI.Validation.AndroidX only for Android Material TextInputLayout extensions.
sourceGeneratorGuidance: Use ReactiveUI.SourceGenerators for validated reactive properties and commands before writing manual RaiseAndSetIfChanged boilerplate.
Validation rules remain runtime pipelines because validity changes dynamically.
compatibilityNotes: INotifyDataErrorInfo is intended for XAML binding; ReactiveUI bindings use BindValidation.
Observable rules must identify target properties when property-level error association is required.
migrationGuidance: Move ad-hoc setter validation to ValidationRule pipelines after properties are generated.
Replace System.Reactive operators with ReactiveUI.Primitives equivalents in lean validation code, keeping .Reactive only at required compatibility boundaries.

harvest.sourceSummary: Official upstream main-branch README and current NuGet package metadata.
